title: Design System: Learning Score Training Room

display.purpose: Welcome headlines and major learning milestones.

body.purpose: Readable course, lesson, and instruction copy.

data.purpose: IDs, dates, versions, timers, and measured progress.

shadows.name: surface-lift
shadows.purpose: Separate a reading surface from the paper ground when needed.

shadows.name: dialog-lift
shadows.purpose: Protected focus for a modal or dialog.

motion.name: notation-step
motion.purpose: A module or marker advances in a short two-frame notation step.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Buttons and fields move between states without theatrical motion.

components.name: Signal Button
components.description: The one primary learning action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-signal-button { background: var(--color-signal); color: var(--color-foreground); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 18px; font: 600 13px/1.4 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-signal-button:hover { background: var(--color-signal-hover); } .ds-signal-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-signal-hover); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-signal-button:active { box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 rgb(24 33 38 / 0.16); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A confident secondary action when the signal button is already present.
components.css: .ds-primary-button { background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--color-primary); border-radius: 4px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 18px; font: 600 13px/1.4 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-primary-button:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover); } .ds-primary-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-signal-hover); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Paper Field
components.description: A quiet field that belongs to the paper reading surface.
components.css: .ds-paper-field { background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 4px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 14px; font: 400 16px/1.5 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-paper-field::placeholder { color: var(--color-foreground-muted); } .ds-paper-field:focus { border-color: var(--color-signal-hover); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-signal-wash); outline: none; }

components.name: Learning Path
components.description: The signature ordered path that makes the next learning step legible.
components.css: .ds-learning-path { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 16px; } .ds-path-mark { display: block; height: 8px; width: 48px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-steel-note); } .ds-path-mark.is-done { background: var(--color-success); } .ds-path-mark.is-current { width: 72px; background: var(--color-signal); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-signal-wash); } .ds-path-mark.is-locked { opacity: 0.65; }

narrative.overview:
This system treats training as a readable score rather than a stack of generic cards. Warm paper is the quiet reading ground; deep score ink carries hierarchy; stepped notation blocks show sequence and dependency; one fluorescent lime marker identifies the current action. The visual world should feel authored and operational, with enough character to be remembered but enough restraint for sensitive policy topics and long-form lessons.

The product name is intentionally not embedded in the mark. The identity survives a future rename and can stretch from compliance into security, policy, business, culture, and other company learning topics.
keyCharacteristics: Notation is functional: it encodes order, progress, version, focus, or dependency.
One high-signal lime state is rarer than the ink and paper field.
Dense information is organized by staff lines, margin notes, and stepped rhythm rather than nested card stacks.

rules.name: The One Marker Rule
rules.body: Signal Lime is the only color allowed to announce “this is the next thing.” Use semantic colors for status, never for primary action.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Sans carries meaning; mono carries measurement. Do not use mono for general copy.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface starts flat. Elevation appears only when a state needs separation.

dos: Do use the current-step marker to make the next learning action obvious within seconds.
Do let real course titles, durations, quiz states, and version notes become the visual content.
Do preserve a quiet paper reading surface for long lessons.
Do use diagrams and annotated examples before stock photography.
Do keep the mark independent from the replaceable product name.
donts: Don't default to blue SaaS gradients, glass panels, or generic metric-card dashboards.
Don't use Signal Lime for paragraphs or large areas; its rarity creates focus.
Don't turn every module into an identical icon card; encode sequence with the learning path.
Don't use decorative grid overlays or notation marks that have no product meaning.
Don't make sensitive training feel playful, alarmist, or punitive.
